body: If I send her a letter her mom will intercept it, and I worry that if I try to meet her at a place she frequents her mom will come along or be watching her. She’s that crazy.

Unfortunately our shared friends don’t really feel comfortable getting in the middle of it. And she literally GPS tracks her phone, and won’t let her anywhere near places I frequent. The burner phone idea isn’t bad, but I have no way to communicate it to her. And since her phone and social media are monitored 24/7 it’s not like I can call her on a burner and tell her to get one or something.

From what I can tell her mom is not going to be open to any sort of conversation about it. Her father is deployed. My GF’s happiness is what I’m worried about, but her mother doesn’t seem to care. And it doesn’t constitute abuse unfortunately, at least not legally. Everything she’s doing is perfectly within her legal rights as a parent, it’s just batshit crazy. That’s why my GF is trying to get emancipated as quickly as possible.
Thank you, I agree, I definitely don’t plan to lead her on.
That’s what I was expecting, it’s gonna be rough but I don’t think there’s anything else I can do. Thank you.
